page.layout: One page of text, single column, with a decorative headpiece above the title; a catchword "Et" at the lower right below the last line. No margin notes.

main_text.head: AD DANIELEM ROSETVM GENEVENSEM, VXORIS meae nepotem, de ficu mortua 1591.
main_text.p: MITTO fata tibi, Rosete, ficus Deplorata meae dolente plectro. Quid? frontem caperas? Seueriores Interdum licet abdicare musas,
main_text.l: Quae nunquam noceant sed vsque prosint.

page.notes: The initial M is a large woodcut initial, joined to "ITTO" as "MITTO". The word "Et" at the lower right is a catchword. The verse lines are set in italic and are given as lines (l) rather than paragraphs, following the printed stanza layout; the first stanza is set with the initial and indented lines.
